title: Choose the game-screen composition
question: Which Match Card composition should the Storybook build carry forward?

options.label: Swap first
options.thesis: The immediate OUT → IN decision owns the screen, with placement available directly beneath it.
options.viewport: Clock, next swap, two field ledgers, then bench—all visible at once.
options.risk: Field movement gets less space than the recommendation.

options.label: Fields first
options.thesis: Player placement owns the screen and the suggested swap bridges the two field ledgers.
options.viewport: Compact clock, two large field ledgers, swap bridge, fixed bench rail.
options.risk: The key fairness decision becomes easier to overlook.

options.label: Queue first
options.thesis: The next swap and two discretionary alternatives form a short rotation queue above the placement ledger.
options.viewport: Clock, layered swap queue, then three-column field and bench placement.
options.risk: Suggested future swaps may imply more prescription than the product intends.
